name: Traditional & African Fashion
shortDescription: Ankara, kente, bazin and lace outfits cut in contemporary or traditional silhouettes.
fabricNotes: Ankara wax print, kente cloth, bazin riche, guipure and cord lace — client-supplied fabric welcome.
highlights: Agbada, kaftan, boubou and dashiki construction
Fitted or flared silhouettes for women's traditional wear
Matching family or group outfits for ceremonies
body: Traditional fabric deserves a cut that respects the print. We plan panel placement before a single piece is cut, so bold Ankara or kente patterns land where they should — not chopped mid-motif at a seam.
From formal agbada and structured kaftans to fitted contemporary silhouettes in lace and bazin, every piece can be built traditional, modern, or somewhere in between.
A regular request for weddings, naming ceremonies and festivals — we coordinate matching outfits for families and groups.
